content.text:
Here's what's left from the plan. Let me propose Phase 2 priorities:

---

## Remaining Phases

### Phase 2 — Stock Detail Enhancements
- **Candlestick chart** option (toggle line ↔ candle, Yahoo-style)
- **1d range** fix — currently uses daily data, should use intraday intervals
- Quote auto-refresh every 60s on Stock Detail page
- Company name shown on Holdings list (already there but sometimes missing)

### Phase 3 — Dashboard Enhancements
- **Top movers** section — biggest % gainers/losers today
- **Day P&L** card — how much your portfolio changed today
- Pull-to-refresh

### Phase 4 — Transactions
- Filter by ticker / buy / sell
- Export to CSV

### Phase 5 — PWA Polish
- Offline banner ("You're offline, showing cached data")
- Install prompt (Add to Home Screen)
- Splash screen

### Phase 6 — Performance & Security
- Refresh token (extend JWT without re-login)
- Rate limiting per user on API
- Input sanitization

---

**Which phase do you want to tackle first?** Or pick specific features from any phase and we'll build those.
